name: Park Jae-hyun
bio:
Park Jae-hyun’s career in motorsport began somewhat unexpectedly. After a stint in the South Korean military as a transport specialist, he transitioned to civilian logistics, eventually landing a role managing freight for a small rally team. The chaos and exhilaration of the racing world were instantly captivating, a stark contrast to the rigid structure he'd known. He's been hooked ever since.

Park's approach to logistics is meticulously planned but adaptable. He anticipates potential disruptions and always has backup solutions. His experience has taught him that meticulous preparation prevents crises. However, he's also learned to trust his instincts and make quick decisions when unforeseen circumstances arise. His reputation is as a problem-solver who never cracks under pressure, a trait that makes him highly sought after in the paddock. He's known for his unwavering loyalty to teams he believes in, often staying for years to see projects through.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly parted with slight receding hairline
physical.description: A man of average height with a slightly weathered face, suggesting years spent outdoors.

quirks: Always carries a small, worn notebook filled with logistical diagrams.
Has a peculiar habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when concentrating.
Insists on drinking green tea at precisely 3:00 PM every day, regardless of location.
